static_traits.name: Zhang Bowen
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships受not安全感影响，出现Social avoidance与群体情境Anxiety；有一些朋友但not yet与其讨论not安全感
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet接受心理治疗；此前not yet出现类似心理问题史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection并配合重构认知；配合度高、Positive attitude；在社交话题上情绪与认知描述具体，报告在群体情境中明显Anxiety与回避

basic_info.main_problem: 感觉他人认为自己without聊和not有趣，因而在Social situations出现Anxiety并Avoiding interaction，影响社交生活并造成痛苦。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些not安全感正在影响我的社交生活并造成我困扰。
growth_experiences: 几个月前，一位朋友对Zhang Bowen的爱好（喜爱披头士乐队、弹贝斯、集邮、古董家具、拥有大量CD）做了随口评价，此后他开始觉得do not人认为自己的兴趣“奇怪/过时”，由此trigger持续的not安全感与Self-doubt；此前have not类似问题或心理治疗史；虽有一些朋友，但not yet与他们讨论这份not安全感。

core_beliefs: 我是一个without聊、not值得被认识的人
我的价值取决于他人是deny可我的兴趣

special_situations.event: 在Meeting new friends并进行初次对话时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的兴趣被认为奇怪或过时，就说明我很without聊，not值得被认识
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 刻意更换话题、尝试谈论更多not同内容以显得更有趣；Avoiding social situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们觉得我很without聊，肯定not想了解我

special_situations.event: 在派对上谈及自己的集邮爱好时，周围人表现出not太感兴趣
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人当下not表现出兴趣，就代表我这个人很without聊
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing talking about my own interests, avoiding similar social topics or occasions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 大家都在觉得我很without聊，是我的问题

special_situations.event: A casual comment by a friend about their interests months ago was overheard by them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他人的评价就是事实，我必须迎合主流兴趣才能避免被认为without聊
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to appear more interesting in conversation to gain others' approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们都觉得我的兴趣很奇怪，所以我not有趣

special_situations.event: Social situations in group settings or interacting with strangers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若我not能让大家觉得有趣，就会被排斥和拒绝
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 提前回避群体互动以避免尴尬或被negate
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我会被他们排斥，谈not起来

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted and liked, expects to be understood and recognized through genuine interests
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected、被评判为without聊，从而失去关系与联系
defense_goal: 通过Avoids socializing来降低被negate的风险
Caters to others' topics to reduce the possibility of being judged

object_relations.object_representation: 他人是挑剔的评判者或not感兴趣的观众

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在Social situations中他人表现Silence或not太感兴趣时（如派对谈论集邮时）
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为对方正在评判自己“without聊”、not值得被认识（移情：将他人视为挑剔的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use温和、Empathy和Clarification式询问；帮助其检视证据与替代Interpretation，避免评判与对抗，鼓励逐步面对社交情境。

manifestations: 在Meeting new friends和群体场合中因担心被评判而回避接触
Excessively ties self-worth to others' opinions; finds it hard to present oneself through genuine interests
频繁自我贴标签为“without聊、not值得被认识”

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: 经常认为他人会觉得自己without聊、在评判自己，即使对方并not yet表态
在派对上将他人的not感兴趣解读为对自己的negate

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心显得without趣而刻意改变话题以迎合他人
Before socializing, over-examines whether I am 'interesting enough', leading to tension and avoidance

positive_force: Has diverse and unique interests (music/instruments/collecting), which can serve as social resources
Willing to try cognitive restructuring and behavioral experiments; highly cooperative
具备自我Reflection能力，能提出替代Interpretation（如意识到他人可能只是not了解集邮）
A certain level of social support exists (has friends to communicate with)
negative_force: Mind reading and personalization cognitive biases, overly concerned with others' evaluations
Social situations的回避行为，Reinforcementnot安全感
Seeks external validation to determine self-worth
在群体情境中的Anticipation性负面判断导致Anxiety（预测not yet来）

antecedent: When attending group activities or parties
When talking about personal interests (such as stamp collecting, the Beatles, bass, etc.)
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人的中性或not熟悉反应解读为对自我的负面评价（读心术、个人化），并预测Being rejected，导致not安全感与Anxiety。
target_behavior.function: 逃避被negate或尴尬的风险，以暂时降低Anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: 社交生活受损，减少互动与练习机会，加重Self-doubt与Loneliness感
